description: This file defines the Goteo ody Search class, which provides methods for performing project searches based on various parameters in a crowdfunding platform.

classes.name: Search
classes.description: Provides static methods for performing project searches with multiple filtering options, such as category, location, reward, query text, node, channel, and status.

methods.name: params
methods.description: Executes a search for projects based on provided parameters, constructing a complex SQL query with filters and orderings. Returns an array of search result widgets.
